_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: No signal & call drops
categories.description: No coverage indoors, weak signal, dropped calls, no service.
keywords: no signal|no network|weak signal|call drop|network (issue|problem|down)|no service|coverage|signal (issue|problem)

categories.name: Slow data & broadband speed
categories.description: Speeds below the plan, buffering, lag, high latency.

categories.name: Internet outages
categories.description: Broadband or mobile data down for hours or days.
keywords: outage|internet (down|not working)|no internet|service down|wifi not working|router|los (red )?light|disconnect|not working|problem today|problems? (in|near)|\bdown\b

categories.name: Recharge & plan price hikes
categories.description: Tariff hikes, mid-contract rises, plan cost increases.

categories.name: Confusing plans, data caps & validity
categories.description: Data caps, validity tricks, fair-usage limits, choosing a plan.

categories.name: Billing errors & hidden charges
categories.description: Wrong bills, extra charges, balance deducted, refunds.

categories.name: Installation & repair visits
categories.description: Missed technician visits, delayed fibre installs, repair waits.

categories.name: Porting, contracts & cancellation
categories.description: Porting refused or slow, lock-ins, early termination fees.

categories.name: SIM, eSIM & KYC
categories.description: SIM blocked or not working, eSIM activation, KYC, SIM swap.

categories.name: Spam calls & SMS
categories.description: Telemarketing, scam calls and messages, DND not working.

categories.name: Customer care
categories.description: Unreachable or unhelpful support; complaints and appeals.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Work-from-home user
personas.description: Depends on home internet for work.
